Consts

addonExts = [".addon", ".so", ".dylib", ".node"]
Loadable native addon extensions. .addon is the canonical, platform-independent name (carne build emits it); platform files and Node-style .node load as-is.

proc insideDir(root, candidate: string): bool {....raises: [],
    tags: [ReadDirEffect], forbids: [].}
True when candidate resolves inside root (both through realpath, so symlinks pointing out fail closed). Non-existent paths fail closed too.

proc loadAddonFile(ctx: JSContextRef; rt: Runtime; spec, path: string;
                   exception: ptr JSValueRef): JSValueRef {.
    ...raises: [KeyError, Exception],
    tags: [ReadDirEffect, RootEffect, WriteIOEffect], forbids: [].}
dlopens path, version-checks it and returns its exports object. spec is the require cache key (absolute path for relative requires, the original spec for pkg/ ones). Callers guarantee containment (requireRelative checks insideDir, pkg subpaths come from resolvePkgImport's containedHit); this proc still fails closed on unreadable files and invalid libraries.
